quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,495.49 million, up 50.66% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 314.78 million, up 45.30%. The company attributes the growth to rapid AI-compute-driven growth of the datacom market, stronger product competitiveness and customer recognition, with orders up year on year. Operating cash flow was RMB -379.74 million because of inventory built up to meet product orders and receivables not yet due on fast-growing sales.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Datacom passive products: the company's CWDM AWG and LAN WDM AWG components are in volume use at mainstream optical-module makers; some MT-FA products for 800G and 1.6T modules are in volume commercial use while others are in customer validation; high-channel-count FAU for CPO advanced packaging has reached small-batch shipments. New in H1 2026: AWG-Lens components for 800G/1.6T modules (small-batch shipments), MT-FA-lens for 800G/1.6T modules (volume shipments), AWG chips and components for 1.6T modules (small batch), DWDM AWG chips and components for CPO (sample shipments), large-channel polarization-maintaining devices for CPO (small batch), high-temperature FAU for automated silicon-photonics packaging (small batch) and 2D FA arrays for OCS (small batch). Its high-precision FAU project for CPO has small-batch orders.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G/1.6T MT-FA in volume; CPO FAU small batch; OCS 2D FA arrays small batch

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Active products: CW DFB light sources for data-center silicon photonics are developed and partly in volume supply; uncooled 100mW CW DFB lasers for silicon photonics are in volume shipments, commercial-temperature 400mW CW DFB lasers in small-batch shipments, and a >900mW high-power MOPA laser for data centers and AI compute was developed. A 100G O-band CWDM-4 EML laser for data centers is sampling to customers; the company says EML prototype development is complete and in customer validation, with commercial ramp expected to follow.
quarterly_data.figure: 100mW CW DFB in volume; 400mW CW DFB small batch; >900mW MOPA developed; 100G EML sampling

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Connectivity: the company's MPO and MMC high-speed connector jumpers passed certification at global mainstream cabling vendors, entered the global supply chain and ship in large, continuous volumes; it developed 1728/3456-fiber ultra-high-count multi-fiber connector jumpers (volume shipments) and 144F-1728F LSZH micro-bundle cables for data and compute centers (small batch).

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management view on the market: in datacom, 800G is in large-scale commercial use, 1.6T is ramping quickly and 3.2T is being laid out ahead, with silicon photonics, LPO, NPO and CPO developing in parallel; AI model training and inference demand is the core growth engine of the datacom market.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shijia Photons half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: on April 17, 2026 the board approved investing RMB 12.65 hundred million in a high-speed optical chip and device development and industrialization project to expand large-scale production capacity of its core products; the company says downstream customer order demand keeps expanding, and the project is being upgraded and expanded to secure order delivery capacity. It is also accelerating capacity build-out at its Thailand subsidiary (H1 2026 revenue RMB 169.10 million) to hedge trade-policy risk.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 12.65 hundred million capacity project; Thailand subsidiary revenue RMB 169.10 million
